name: Vampyr Lord applies its damage aura to an Animated Blood summon (#576)
contract: Vampyr Lord 560259 uses SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_APPLY_AURA_TO_SUMMONS (SpellEffects.cpp) which iterates the owner's controlled summons and applies the spell's own aura (effect 0, SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE = 79, +35%) to any live, owned, in-map summon (SpellAuras.cpp, case SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_APPLY_AURA_TO_SUMMONS). Animated Blood is summoned by spell 573357 (rank 3 of the 573299 chain, the only rank a level-80 character owns per AscensionSpellProgressionData.h: 573356 at level 20, 573357 at level 30), which spawns creature 315301, one of the AscensionBloodmageTalents.cpp AnimatedBloodSummons entries. The harness has no way to read a dynamically-summoned pet's individual aura amount (only the player-scoped players/creatures actors support aura metrics), so this checks presence of the caster's own aura instance on the live summon via owned_creature_count's spell filter, learned vs unlearned, rather than the exact +35% magnitude.

steps.label: Summon has no Vampyr Lord aura before it is learned
Summon gains the Vampyr Lord damage aura once learned
Summon loses the aura once Vampyr Lord is unlearned
